continuity_scope: One Piece, Vol. 1, VIZ English paperback/digital edition (2 September 2003; ISBN 978-1-56931-901-7; 216 pages), credited to Eiichiro Oda. This is a narrow English manga-volume pass. Shueisha's original Japanese ONE PIECE 1 (24 December 1997; ISBN 4-08-872509-3) is used only as a separate original-edition/translation boundary, not merged wording or character evidence.

coverage_rule: Include only named individual dramatic characters directly named by the selected VIZ English Volume 1 synopsis: Monkey D. Luffy and the buccaneer "Red-Haired" Shanks. Their explicitly stated formative inspiration relationship is included. The legendary One Piece is an item, and pirate/King-of-the-Pirates are roles; neither creates a character node. The preview-reader landing page exposes no practical searchable chapter/panel text, so claims remain official-metadata level.
omissions: All other Volume 1 names, Luffy's later crew, pirate and marine groups, factions, islands/seas, Devil Fruit users, and antagonists are omitted because the selected VIZ synopsis does not name/profile them.

All later manga volumes/chapters, Japanese serialization and original Volume 1 wording, anime, films, games, novels, guidebooks, stage works, live-action, card game, merchandise, and other adaptations are separate witnesses.

Pirate/marine roles, crews/factions, Devil Fruits as a category, items, islands/seas, and themes remain terms/dimensions rather than character nodes; Haki is absent from this witness and is not added.

The selected metadata frames fictional piracy, a hazardous loss of swimming ability, and a Teen-rated adventure but does not establish colonial systems, a history of real-world piracy, a full violence/death record, coercion, or outcomes. Such broader-franchise material is not imported.
uncertainties: The VIZ Volume 1 product page provides a primary reader landing page but no browser-searchable chapter/panel text or locator. It proves an official preview, not a panel-level text extraction.

VIZ supports Luffy's childhood inspiration, accidental Gum-Gum Devil Fruit consumption, rubber-stretching ability, inability to swim, rowboat departure, and One Piece objective. It does not provide a full Devil Fruit taxonomy, pirate-law system, crew roster, Haki, combat record, or outcome.
The Japanese Shueisha Volume 1 metadata gives its own original-language synopsis and names G. Roger. That name and wording are not transferred into this English-edition pass.

Piracy is source-specific adventure terminology here, not a statement about real historical pirates, colonialism, maritime law, or present-day communities. Violence, hazardous seafaring, and disability-related implications are cautions rather than exhaustive plot or clinical claims.

VIZ's official series page and the authorized One Piece links page visibly distinguish manga/comics, anime, live action, games, novels, and other products; none is treated as interchangeable continuity evidence.
evidence_basis: VIZ first-party English Volume 1 product/preview and series metadata, with Shueisha and the authorized One Piece official page used only to document original-edition and adaptation separation. No fan wiki, Wikipedia, anime recap, game database, novel, guidebook, live-action summary, or uninspected panel transcription is used as character evidence.
